nodes.label: Raspberry Pi OS Default Credentials Exploitation
nodes.precondition: Target Raspberry Pi running Raspberry Pi OS version <= 5.10 accessible over network or local console with default 'pi' account and 'raspberry' password unchanged.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker obtains authenticated administrative (sudo/root) access to the Raspberry Pi OS environment.

nodes.label: piSignage Arbitrary File Download (Path Traversal)
nodes.precondition: piSignage version < 2.6.4 running on target Raspberry Pi; attacker possesses authenticated low-privilege user credentials for the web application.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker reads and downloads arbitrary files from the host Raspberry Pi filesystem via api/settings/log?file=../, potentially exposing sensitive configuration files and credentials.

nodes.label: RaspAP Web Console Command Execution
nodes.precondition: RaspAP version 2.5 installed; attacker has authenticated access to the web interface with access to includes/webconsole.php.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker executes arbitrary OS-level commands, uploads files, and runs malicious code on the underlying Raspberry Pi operating system.

nodes.label: Raspberry Pi Glowworm Optical Side-Channel Eavesdropping
nodes.precondition: Raspberry Pi 3 B+ or 4 B (firmware/hardware through 2021-08-09) powering connected audio speakers; optical line of sight to the device's power indicator LED exists; attacker equipped with telescope and electro-optical sensor.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker reconstructs acoustic signals and speech played through the speakers via power fluctuation analysis of the power LED, compromising audio confidentiality.

nodes.label: Oculus Browser HTML UI Injection and Code Execution
nodes.precondition: Oculus Browser versions 5.2.7 through 5.7.11 running; user visits an attacker-controlled remote web page.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker injects arbitrary HTML into the Oculus Browser UI, achieving UI spoofing and executing code within the unprivileged user context on the host system.

nodes.label: Oculus Desktop OVRRedir.exe Hard Link Arbitrary File Write
nodes.precondition: Oculus Desktop version < 1.44.0.32849 installed on Windows; attacker has unprivileged local code execution/file system access.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker creates a hard link to target critical system files from an unprivileged log file written by privileged OVRRedir.exe, enabling arbitrary file overwrite and local privilege escalation to SYSTEM.

nodes.label: Oculus Desktop OVRServiceLauncher Process Handle Leak
nodes.precondition: Oculus Desktop versions between 1.39 and 31.1.0.67.507 installed on Windows; attacker has unprivileged local process execution rights.
nodes.postcondition: Privileged process handle exposed to an unprivileged process via handle management bug, allowing attacker to manipulate privileged processes and achieve local privilege escalation.

nodes.label: NVIDIA Jetson Linux IOMMU Misconfiguration Memory Access
nodes.precondition: Target device running vulnerable NVIDIA Jetson Linux distribution; attacker possesses direct physical access to the board and PCI bus interface.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker achieves direct read/write access to the complete system physical address space via the PCI bus, enabling arbitrary kernel memory corruption, code execution, privilege escalation, denial of service, and full platform compromise.
